name: Norbaeocystin
summary: Norbaeocystin, also known as 4-phosphoryloxytryptamine (4-PO-T), is a psilocybin mushroom alkaloid of the tryptamine family and an analogue of psilocybin (4-PO-DMT). It is found as a minor compound in most psilocybin mushrooms, together with psilocybin, psilocin (4-HO-DMT), aeruginascin (4-PO-TMT), and baeocystin (4-PO-NMT), from which it is a derivative.

pharmacology.text: Norbaeocystin (4-PO-T) is thought to be a prodrug of 4-hydroxytryptamine (4-HT), analogously to how psilocybin (4-PO-DMT) is a prodrug of psilocin (4-HO-DMT) and baeocystin (4-PO-NMT) is thought to be a prodrug of norpsilocin (4-HO-NMT). 4-HT is a potent and centrally penetrant serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and also interacts with other serotonin receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: Norbaeocystin is generally thought to be non-psychoactive, although this has not been confirmed.
